batch: 4 (chs 28-35, the woes on Ephraim/Jerusalem and the highway)

units.characteristics: the refused rest; the numbed teachers; the word made a mockery
units.gist: the drunkards of Ephraim; even priest and prophet 'reel with strong drink... stumble in giving judgment'; God offered 'THIS IS REST; give rest to the weary... yet they WOULD NOT HEAR'; so his word became 'precept upon precept, line upon line' - the offered rest refused, the intoxicated faculties, the word turned to a snare

units.characteristics: the false refuge of lies; the tested cornerstone; faith that is not in haste
units.gist: GEM - 'we have made a covenant with DEATH... we have made LIES OUR REFUGE, and in falsehood we have taken shelter'; against it 'I am the one who has laid in Zion a stone, a TESTED STONE, a precious CORNERSTONE... whoever BELIEVES WILL NOT BE IN HASTE'; the farmer taught by God (wise, measured discipline) - the lie-refuge vs the sure foundation; faith as un-panicked rest

units.characteristics: honour with the lips while the heart is far; the spirit of deep sleep
units.gist: THE GEM - Ariel besieged; 'the LORD has poured out a spirit of DEEP SLEEP'; 'because this people draw near with their MOUTH and honour me with their LIPS, while their HEARTS ARE FAR FROM ME, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men' - worship that is outwardly near and inwardly absent; the sealed vision

units.characteristics: the creature disputing its Maker; the meek given fresh joy
units.gist: 'you TURN THINGS UPSIDE DOWN! Shall the POTTER be regarded as the CLAY, that the thing made should say of its maker, He did not make me?'; then reversal - 'the MEEK shall obtain fresh JOY in the LORD, the poor shall exult in the Holy One'; 'those who go astray in spirit will come to understanding' - the clay presuming against the Potter; joy given to the lowly

units.characteristics: wanting smooth things; salvation refused in returning, rest, quietness, trust
units.gist: THE GEM - stubborn children going to Egypt not asking God; 'say to the seers, Do not see... speak to us SMOOTH THINGS, prophesy ILLUSIONS' (the ear that refuses truth); 'IN RETURNING AND REST you shall be saved; in QUIETNESS AND IN TRUST shall be your strength. BUT YOU WERE UNWILLING' - the offered salvation of quiet trust, refused for the flight on horses

units.characteristics: the God who waits to be gracious; the Teacher no longer hidden; the guiding voice
units.gist: 'the LORD WAITS to be gracious to you... blessed are all those who WAIT for him'; 'your Teacher will not hide himself anymore, your eyes shall SEE your Teacher; your ears shall hear a word behind you, THIS IS THE WAY, WALK IN IT'; healing 'the brokenness of his people' - the patient gracious God; the inner ear guided; idols cast away as unclean

units.characteristics: reliance on flesh not God; man vs God, flesh vs spirit
units.gist: GEM - 'woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on HORSES... but do not LOOK to the Holy One of Israel'; 'the EGYPTIANS ARE MAN, AND NOT GOD, and their horses are FLESH, AND NOT SPIRIT'; 'TURN to him from whom people have deeply revolted' - trust in the creaturely (flesh) exposed against God (spirit); the call to turn

units.characteristics: the fool vs the noble heart; the Spirit poured out; peace as the effect of righteousness
units.gist: GEM - the king who reigns in righteousness, each 'like a hiding place from the wind'; the FOOL whose 'heart is busy with iniquity' vs the NOBLE who 'plans noble things and on noble things he stands'; the complacent women shaken; 'until the SPIRIT IS POURED upon us from on high'; 'the effect of righteousness will be PEACE, and the result... QUIETNESS AND TRUST FOREVER'

units.characteristics: who may dwell with the consuming fire; the fear of the LORD as treasure; the king in his beauty
units.gist: GEM - 'O LORD, be gracious to us; WE WAIT for you; be our arm every morning'; 'the FEAR OF THE LORD is Zion's TREASURE'; 'who among us can DWELL WITH THE CONSUMING FIRE?... He who WALKS RIGHTEOUSLY and speaks uprightly, who despises unjust gain... he will dwell on the heights'; 'your eyes will behold the KING IN HIS BEAUTY'

units.characteristics: the day of recompense; nothing left to chance in judgment
units.gist: the LORD's day of vengeance on the nations/Edom; the sword 'sated with blood'; the land turned to burning pitch; 'seek and read from the book of the LORD: not one of these shall be missing' - the thoroughness and certainty of judgment (thin inner-being; mostly external pole)

units.characteristics: the anxious heart strengthened; the ransomed returning with everlasting joy
units.gist: THE GEM - 'strengthen the weak hands, make firm the feeble knees; say to those who have an ANXIOUS HEART, Be strong; FEAR NOT! Behold, your God will come and save you'; the Way of Holiness; 'the RANSOMED of the LORD shall return with SINGING; EVERLASTING JOY upon their heads; and SORROW AND SIGHING SHALL FLEE AWAY' - the fearful heart heartened; joy overtaking sorrow
